name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: keep original ioBroker ObjectBrowser write semantics: common.write=false read-only, otherwise writable
remove EOS unrestricted/capture write paths; datapoint clicks use native ObjectBrowserValue dialog
stabilize ObjectBrowser value-cell click handling with stopPropagation and a click target while state cache is still loading
fix ObjectBrowser tooltip startup when tooltipInfo is not yet loaded; hover details now get a non-empty fallback and safe state default
do not let EOS branding/security/role observers scan or touch the native datapoints/logs table and MUI tooltip/popup surfaces
keep stale eos-performance-guard.js neutralized as no-op compatibility shim
make console quiet filter resistant to late console rewrites and %%c-prefixed admin debug logs
preserve delete/logquiet/role-guard fixes from previous versions
notes: Native ObjectBrowser DP writes; no ignored clicks while states cache is loading; v53 performance guard neutralized; reduced console/DOM noise.
description: Restores the stable native ioBroker ObjectBrowser datapoint flow while preserving the NexoWatt EOS design and role/delete fixes.
